text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- National Bank of Macedonia governor dismess owner and general manager of private savings and loan bank TAT from Bitola. Appeal made to depositors to be patient and promises given their intersets will be protected.
- Macedonia to open embassy in Toronto. More than 150,000 Macedonian emigrants live in Canada.
- Macedonian defense minister Blagoja Handziski to visit U.S. soon, expected to discuss extension of UNPREDEP mission and Macedonia's membership in NATO.

- Very few crossings at border with Albania. Albanian police patrols spotted from the other side of the border. According to Macedonian border officials Albanians have strengthened border controls towards Macedonia.

- Opposition IMRO-DPMNY party condemned police activities against the students who are on a hunger strike in front of parliament against a new law introducing use of minority languages in the Teachers' academy. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
